data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-m-m', meaning 'to comfort'. In Islamic culture, Neima is a name given to a child born during times of hardship, symbolizing hope and comfort. The name Neima carries the meaning “Comforting, Consoling” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Neima usually hope their child will grow to embody comforting, consoling and live with faith, good character and purpose.
